## Toolset `core`

### `status`

Working-copy status: staged, unstaged, untracked and conflicted files, and the stack position. Ignored files are never listed.

- Surfaces: stdio
- Backing call: `Workspace.Status`
- Needs: `None`
- Confirmation: never
- Annotations: readOnly=true, idempotent=true, destructive=false, openWorld=false

Arguments (stdio):

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `cursor` | string | no | Continuation from a previous reply's next_cursor. |
| `max_files` | integer | no | Files listed per section. |
| `max_tokens` | integer | no | Cap on the reply size in tokens (estimated as bytes / 3). |
| `paths` | array of any | no |  |
| `untracked` | boolean | no |  |
| `worktree` | string | no | Worktree path from the worktrees tool; omit for the launch workspace. |

### `diff`

Diff between two states: from and to are index, worktree or a revision (default HEAD to worktree). The patch is cut at hunk boundaries; continue with next_cursor.

- Surfaces: stdio
- Backing call: `Workspace.Diff`
- Needs: `None`
- Confirmation: never
- Annotations: readOnly=true, idempotent=true, destructive=false, openWorld=false

Arguments (stdio):

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `context` | integer | no |  |
| `cursor` | string | no | Continuation from a previous reply's next_cursor. |
| `format` | any | no |  |
| `from` | string | no |  |
| `max_files` | integer | no | Files listed per page. |
| `max_tokens` | integer | no | Cap on the reply size in tokens (estimated as bytes / 3). |
| `paths` | array of any | no | "index" \| "worktree" \| revspec |
| `to` | string | no |  |
| `worktree` | string | no | Worktree path from the worktrees tool; omit for the launch workspace. |

## Toolset `write`

### `stage`

Stage or unstage paths, or apply a patch to the index. Ignored paths are never staged.

- Surfaces: stdio
- Backing call: `Workspace.Stage`
- Needs: `WriteLocal`
- Confirmation: never
- Annotations: readOnly=false, idempotent=true, destructive=false, openWorld=false

Arguments (stdio):

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `add` | array of any | no |  |
| `patch` | any | no |  |
| `remove` | array of any | no |  |
| `worktree` | string | no | Worktree path from the worktrees tool; omit for the launch workspace. |

### `create`

Create a change on top of the current one with the given message. No editor runs, so the message is required.

- Surfaces: stdio
- Backing call: `asc create --json`
- Needs: `WriteLocalOrRemote`
- Confirmation: never
- Annotations: readOnly=false, idempotent=false, destructive=false, openWorld=false

Arguments (stdio):

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `all` | boolean | no |  |
| `insert` | boolean | no |  |
| `message` | string | yes | required: no editor runs |
| `onto` | string | no |  |
| `worktree` | string | no | Worktree path from the worktrees tool; omit for the launch workspace. |

### `modify`

Amend the current change with the working-copy edits (all stages everything), or start a new change with new_change.

- Surfaces: stdio
- Backing call: `asc modify --json`
- Needs: `WriteLocalOrRemote`
- Confirmation: never
- Annotations: readOnly=false, idempotent=false, destructive=false, openWorld=false

Arguments (stdio):

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `all` | boolean | no |  |
| `into` | string | no |  |
| `message` | string | no |  |
| `new_change` | boolean | no | `-c` |
| `worktree` | string | no | Worktree path from the worktrees tool; omit for the launch workspace. |

### `absorb`

Move working-copy hunks into the changes of the stack that last touched those lines. Previews unless apply is true.

- Surfaces: stdio
- Backing call: `asc absorb --json`
- Needs: `WriteLocalOrRemote`
- Confirmation: never
- Annotations: readOnly=false, idempotent=false, destructive=false, openWorld=false

Arguments (stdio):

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `apply` | boolean | no | false: preview only |
| `into` | string | no |  |
| `worktree` | string | no | Worktree path from the worktrees tool; omit for the launch workspace. |

### `restack`

Rebase changes onto their updated parents. scope selects all, downstack, upstack or only the given change.

- Surfaces: stdio
- Backing call: `asc restack --json`
- Needs: `WriteLocalOrRemote`
- Confirmation: never
- Annotations: readOnly=false, idempotent=true, destructive=false, openWorld=false

Arguments (stdio):

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `change` | string | no |  |
| `scope` | any | no |  |
| `worktree` | string | no | Worktree path from the worktrees tool; omit for the launch workspace. |

### `undo`

Undo one operation, named by the op id from your earlier result. Refused with STALE_OP unless it is the latest in the op log.

- Surfaces: stdio
- Backing call: `asc undo --json`
- Needs: `WriteLocalOrRemote`
- Confirmation: per `asc.mcp.confirm`
- Annotations: readOnly=false, idempotent=false, destructive=true, openWorld=false

Arguments (stdio):

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `dry_run` | boolean | no |  |
| `op` | string | yes | from an earlier OpResult; STALE_OP unless current |
| `worktree` | string | no | Worktree path from the worktrees tool; omit for the launch workspace. |

### `redo`

Redo the latest undone operation, named by its op id.

- Surfaces: stdio
- Backing call: `asc redo --json`
- Needs: `WriteLocalOrRemote`
- Confirmation: never
- Annotations: readOnly=false, idempotent=false, destructive=false, openWorld=false

Arguments (stdio):

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `dry_run` | boolean | no |  |
| `op` | string | yes | from an earlier OpResult; STALE_OP unless current |
| `worktree` | string | no | Worktree path from the worktrees tool; omit for the launch workspace. |

### `worktree_create`

Add a worktree at path for a revision, optionally ephemeral with a ttl such as 7d.

- Surfaces: stdio
- Backing call: `asc worktree add --json`
- Needs: `WriteLocal`
- Confirmation: never
- Annotations: readOnly=false, idempotent=false, destructive=false, openWorld=false

Arguments (stdio):

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `ephemeral` | boolean | no |  |
| `mode` | string | no | "virtual" or "plain" |
| `path` | string | yes |  |
| `rev` | string | no |  |
| `ttl` | string | no | "7d" |
| `worktree` | string | no | Worktree path from the worktrees tool; omit for the launch workspace. |

### `sync`

Fetch, restack onto the updated trunk and optionally delete merged changes. Asks for confirmation when delete_merged is true.

- Surfaces: stdio
- Backing call: `asc sync --json`
- Needs: `WriteRemote`
- Confirmation: when `delete_merged` is true
- Annotations: readOnly=false, idempotent=false, destructive=false, openWorld=true

Arguments (stdio):

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `delete_merged` | boolean | no |  |
| `fetch` | boolean | no | default true |
| `restack` | boolean | no | default true |
| `worktree` | string | no | Worktree path from the worktrees tool; omit for the launch workspace. |

### `submit`

Upload a change or the whole stack for review. Always asks for confirmation. Drafts unless draft is false.

- Surfaces: stdio
- Backing call: `asc submit --json`
- Needs: `WriteRemote`
- Confirmation: always
- Annotations: readOnly=false, idempotent=false, destructive=true, openWorld=true

Arguments (stdio):

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `change` | string | no |  |
| `draft` | boolean | no | default: asc.stack.submit.draft, else true |
| `force` | boolean | no |  |
| `reviewers` | array of string | no |  |
| `update_only` | boolean | no |  |
| `whole_stack` | boolean | no |  |
| `worktree` | string | no | Worktree path from the worktrees tool; omit for the launch workspace. |

### `commit`

Create a changeset from file operations. update_ref must be empty (a draft change) or refs/for/*; any other value is refused.

- Surfaces: http
- Backing call: `Repo.Commit`
- Needs: `ServerWriteMcp`
- Confirmation: when `update_ref` is `refs/for/*`
- Annotations: readOnly=false, idempotent=false, destructive=false, openWorld=false

Arguments (http):

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `expect` | any | no |  |
| `message` | any | no |  |
| `ops` | array of any | no |  |
| `parent` | string | no |  |
| `repo` | string | yes | Repository as owner/name. |
| `update_ref` | string | no |  |

### `submit`

Upload changes for review through the push pipeline. Always asks for confirmation.

- Surfaces: http
- Backing call: `UpdateRefs refs/for/<trunk>/asc-<change>`
- Needs: `ServerWrite`
- Confirmation: always
- Annotations: readOnly=false, idempotent=false, destructive=true, openWorld=false

Arguments (http):

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `changes` | array of string | yes | Change ids to submit. |
| `draft` | boolean | no | Submit as drafts. |
| `force` | boolean | no | Overwrite a diverged remote version. |
| `reviewers` | array of string | no | Reviewer names. |

### `rebase`

Rebase head onto onto and report conflicts. dry_run defaults to true; update_ref must be empty or refs/for/*.

- Surfaces: http
- Backing call: `Repo.Rebase`
- Needs: `ServerWrite`
- Confirmation: when `update_ref` is set and the call is not a dry run
- Annotations: readOnly=false, idempotent=false, destructive=false, openWorld=false

Arguments (http):

| Argument | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `base` | string | no |  |
| `dry_run` | boolean | no |  |
| `expect` | any | no |  |
| `head` | string | no |  |
| `head_repo` | any | no |  |
| `onto` | string | no |  |
| `repo` | string | yes | Repository as owner/name. |
| `resolutions` | array of any | no |  |
| `update_ref` | string | no |  |

Restack changes onto a new base. dry_run defaults to true.

- Surfaces: http
- Backing call: `Changes.RestackChanges`
- Needs: `ServerWrite`
- Confirmation: never

| `atomic` | boolean | no |  |
